challenges.title: Clean your next three features
challenges.description: Three features you haven't cleaned yet, cleaned in January. Next up shows the ones you're ready for. Sketchy goes and walk-throughs along the way are all part of it.

challenges.title: 30-day manual challenge
challenges.description: Log 10 manual sessions in 30 days. Short and often beats one long session: 10 minutes in a parking lot counts.
